content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-costing-you-3|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-explained-digital-5|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-6|Cloudflare Workers]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad, a popular platform for selling digital products, operates in over 190 countries, but its fees can range from 3.5% + $0.30 per sale to 8% + $0.30 per sale. Stripe, on the other hand, is available in 46 countries but charges a flat 2.9% + $0.3 per transaction. In contrast, NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, operates globally with no fees for the creator and a 0.5% fee for the buyer, with recommended networks for low fees including BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Stripe impose restrictions on countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan, while NOWPayments does not, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer for creators in these regions. This is because Gumroad and Stripe rely on conventional payment processors like Stripe, PayPal, and Lemon Squeezy, which are often unavailable or severely restricted in these countries. In contrast, NOWPayments uses cryptocurrency payment processing, which is not subject to the same restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad's fees can be high, especially for creators in countries with unfavorable exchange rates, while Stripe's fees are more predictable but still high. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a flat 0.5% fee for the buyer, with no fees for the creator, making it a more cost-effective option for creators in restricted countries. Furthermore, NOWPayments' use of cryptocurrency payment processing enables fast and secure transactions, with settlement times often under 1 hour.
Gumroad and Stripe are not the only options for selling digital products, but they are often the most convenient, despite their limitations.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Stripe require creators to rely on their infrastructure, which can be a liability in countries with restricted access to conventional payment processors. In contrast, NOWPayments provides a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, enabling creators to own and control their own infrastructure, automate payment processing, and deliver products directly to customers without relying on Gumroad or Stripe.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Creators in countries with restricted access to conventional payment processors should choose NOWPayments for its low fees, fast transaction times, and permanent structural alternative at the base layer. For creators who require more advanced infrastructure, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete solution for hosting, storage, and payment processing, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Creators in restricted countries should consider NOWPayments as a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.

If you're looking for a Stripe alternative for Nigeria digital sellers or a platform to sell digital products without a Gumroad account, consider the permanent structural alternative provided by NOWPayments. For more advanced infrastructure, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a complete solution for hosting, storage, and payment processing. You can shop our products, including the Edge Commerce Stack, at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
